title: EvaluatorInput
description: The image is what is under review. The claim is the specification it is checked against.

image.description: Local file path or http(s) URL to the math visual under review. Supported: PNG, JPEG, WEBP (detected by file signature, not by extension). At most 10 MB.

claim.description: The specification the image is checked against. Either a claim about what the image shows ("The chart shows 12 apples.") or a question with its expected answer in the form `Question: "<question>" The answer is <answer>.`
